evidence.agent: Ostrander Bell LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: Class relief and attorneys’ fees were addressed together; I do not represent that fees were negotiated only after class relief was agreed.
with any reduction in court-approved fees added to the class fund rather than returned to Brightline.

summary: Plaintiffs raised fee terms in their opening public proposals, and the final declaration confirms fees and class relief were addressed together rather than sequentially. Fee terms were linked to class recovery only in the sense that any court-reduced fees would be added to the class fund. The transcript does not show plaintiff self-dealing, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
